name: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach
kicker: Mary and child on Big Mountain
summary: A 32 m white Mary holding the Child on Big Mountain: a short daytime stop for the statue and the sea. She stands 60 metres above the water on the slope above Bãi Dâu, with a large church beside her. She was inaugurated at the end of 1994. Pair her with Bach Dinh or the cable car on the same hill.
getThere: The Big Mountain slope above Bãi Dâu.
heroCaption: Mary holding the child, head and the child’s arms in frame

notice.title: Christ is on the other hill
notice.body: Christ the King, also white and 32 metres tall, stands on Small Mountain with both arms out. Mary, on Big Mountain, holds the Child.

body: The statue faces the sea from the Big Mountain slope above Bãi Dâu, Mulberry Beach. Building started in 1992, and she was inaugurated on 31 December 1994. She is 32 metres tall and stands 60 metres above the water.
Beside her is the church, begun in 1994: 46 by 26 metres, with seats for 1,000. Come in daylight so the white figure stands out against the sky.
Phổ Đà Sơn, a Teochew temple with an 18 metre white Guanyin, is on the same hillside road, 500 metres from Bãi Dâu.

figures.caption: The full Mary figure on the hill, with the church and its cross beside the road
figures.alt: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach on Big Mountain, with the church nearby

gettingThere: The statue is on the Big Mountain slope above Bãi Dâu, north of Front Beach on the Trần Phú side of the hill. Take a taxi or motorbike taxi from either beach.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: North along Trần Phú, the shore road round Big Mountain, to Bãi Dâu.

legs.heading: From the Ho May station
legs.body: The lower station, 1A Trần Phú, is on the same side of the hill.
